title: Shorten the overspeed warning time TBC008
executive_summary:
Short answer: this ECR shortens overspeed warning timer TBC008 from 8s to 6s in the Speed Enforcement Module (RCMP-011) — you must verify the overspeed warning still appears before any enforcement and run the three recommended regression tests: TC-5060 (P0), TC-5062 (P1) and TC-5068 (P2). (ECR-2026-034)

Why: the safety board approved the 6s change but explicitly required the warning to precede enforcement (CMT-3021).  
What to focus on: the top test TC-5060 is the P0 regression that specifically verifies “warning before enforcement” and targets the modified module (TC-5060).  
Risk context: a prior critical production defect caused the warning to appear after enforcement because the timer was started from the wrong threshold, and the chance of recurrence is High (PTC-4501).  
Additional coverage: TC-5062 verifies penalty-brake application and event recording (L2R1510) and TC-5068 verifies braking/curve behavior at heavy-haul limits (L2R1811) — run and record evidence for these (TC-5062, TC-5068; EV-5021 shows prior timing evidence but evidence gaps remain for L2R1420 and L2R1510).
